title: Compliance e Governança de TI
description:
Compliance e Governança de TI

A pessoa de Compliance e Governança de TI atua em conformidade e gestão de rituais tecnológicos, sendo responsável por garantir que os controles, rituais e manutenções de conformidade ocorram na prática e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Você será o guardião dos frameworks de segurança, privacidade e inteligência artificial, montando calendários e garantindo que a empresa esteja pronta para auditorias. O papel combina um perfil executor com alto senso de protagonismo e visão técnica de frameworks.

Quais serão as suas responsabilidades?

  • Gestão de Frameworks: Garantir a implementação, manutenção e eficácia dos controles relativos às normas ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 e a nova ISO 42001.
  • Conformidade Legal: Assegurar o cumprimento da LGPD e GDPR em conjunto com o time jurídico.
  • Dono(a) dos Rituais: Planejar e executar rituais de governança (reuniões de análise crítica, revisões de acessos, testes de controles, etc.).
  • Calendário de Compliance: Criar e gerir um cronograma anual de atividades, garantindo que nenhum prazo de recertificação seja perdido.
  • Interface com Auditoria: Liderar os processos de auditoria interna e externa, preparando evidências e coordenando planos de ação.
  • Monitoramento Ativo: Validar tecnicamente se os controles estão operacionais e sugerir melhorias práticas.

O que buscamos?

  • Protagonismo: Ser dono dos processos, garantindo que a conformidade ocorra na prática.
  • Perfil Hands-on: Capacidade de executar tarefas, gerar evidências e documentar processos de ponta a ponta.
  • Organização: Capacidade de organizar e gerir calendários e múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Foco no que importa: Garantir que a entrega aconteça, atuando como o ponto focal de confiança para a governança.

Idealmente, você tem:

  • Background: Experiência sólida com os frameworks ISO 27001 e ISO 27701.
  • Outras habilidades/credentials específicas: Vivência em certificação SOC 2, conhecimento na norma ISO 42001 (Gestão de IA) e domínio da LGPD/GDPR.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prática em frameworks de segurança e privacidade.
  • Diferenciais: Certificações ISO Lead Auditor, CIPP, CIPM ou vivência em ITIL.

title: Client Partnerships Director - Latin America
description:
Client Partnerships Director - Latin America

About Genero

Genero is revolutionizing creative content production, leveraging technology to empower in-house marketing and creative teams. Our flexible creative solution integrates the world’s largest professional creative network with a software platform and streamlined end-to-end workflow, delivering an unparalleled creative and production offering for our clients.

With offices across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, our esteemed client base includes Google, Meta, TikTok, L’Oréal, Diageo, Hilton, and Michaels. Joining Genero means becoming a key player in a dynamic and innovative global company, contributing to the expansion of our business across North America, one of our fastest-growing regions.

Reporting to the Managing Director – Latin America, you’ll be a vital member of our Americas team and collaborate across our global team. This is a pivotal role for a strategic thinker and trusted client partner, ready to guide brands through the future of content and production.

What you’ll do

  • Proactively source, qualify and convert new business opportunities, leading discovery, pitches and proposals to win new clients and expand existing relationships.
  • Drive growth and retention across our Enterprise client base by building long-term, trusted partnerships with senior marketing leaders and identifying upsell and cross sell opportunities.

  • Be a trusted advisor to clients, offering strategic input, platform insights, and content best practices to deliver impactful creative and campaigns that perform.
  • Define commercial approaches for ongoing social content arrangements, translating client needs into clear scopes, pricing and statements of work in partnerships with internal teams.
  • Partner with Creative Strategy, Production and Client Services to scope opportunities accurately and ensure a clear handover from sold work into delivery teams.
  • Support key enterprise and platform partnership programs by aligning stakeholders, clarifying objectives and ensuring commercial and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with our creative community and internal teams to ensure proposed solutions are credible, high quality and aligned with performance goals.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across the Americas and globally to share learnings, surface growth opportunities, and drive operational excellence.

The role offers flexible hybrid working, combining remote work with in-person collaboration with our São Paulo-based team.

What you’ll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in marketing, advertising, creative production, digital media or related fields
  • 8+ years experience in a creative or social agency, brand, production studio, or social platform environment, with a track record of winning new business and growing enterprise accounts.
  • Demonstrated experience selling social and digital content solutions, ideally including ongoing or program based arrangements (always-on, scaled production, and creator/influencer programs)
  • A deep understanding of social and digital content best practices
  • Strong demonstrated ability to build and maintain trusted senior relationships, lead consultative discovery and influence stakeholders through to commercial agreement
  • Confidence in translating strategy into commercial packaging: scopes, pricing, proposals and SoWs, in partnerships with internal teams
  • Previous experience working directly with social and tech platforms – Meta, Google, Pinterest, TikTok etc. is a major plus
  • Strong cross functional leadership: able to align Creative Strategy, Production and Client Services around a clear plan and smooth handover from sold work to delivery
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills
  • Strong commercial judgement and organisational skills, including pipeline management, forecasting and prioritisation
  • Fluent English is Mandatory. Fluent Spanish is highly desirable.

title: Oracle Funcional Consultant Projects Cloud
description:

Main activities and responsibilities

  • Monitor and support project execution flows, validating project statuses, task structures, cost collection, accounting outcomes, and downstream financial impact.

  • Validate and maintain Projects Cloud configurations, ensuring alignment with project financial policies, costing rules, billing setups, and business requirements.
  • Execute functional testing, including regression tests for Oracle quarterly updates and changes that may impact Projects Cloud processes and integrations.
  • Perform functional impact analysis for configuration changes, small enhancements, or integration updates affecting Projects Cloud and related Financials modules.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to diagnose integration impacts involving OIC, ODI, REST/SOAP services, and integrations with GL, AP, AR, Procurement, and upstream systems.
  • Maintain clear functional documentation, including incident records, root‑cause analysis, project process guides, test evidence, and configuration tracking.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and functional guidance to junior team members and business users when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience working with Oracle Projects Cloud in enterprise environments.
  • Solid understanding of project financial management processes, including project costing, project billing, project revenue, budgeting, and project lifecycle management.
  • Hands‑on experience with Projects Cloud functional configuration, such as Project Units, Business Units, Project Types, Project Templates, Task Structures, Resource Breakdown Structures (RBS), and Burdening Configurations.
  • Good understanding of project cost and accounting concepts, including expenditure types, expenditure categories, cost collection, cost distribution, burden costs, and accounting events.
  • Experience analyzing and resolving incidents related to project cost issues, billing errors, revenue recognition problems, budget control exceptions, and accounting inconsistencies within Projects Cloud.
  • Familiarity with FBDI, ESS jobs, OTBI, and BI Publisher reports for project data loads, transactional processing, and operational/project financial reporting.
  • Experience working in AMS environments, supporting incidents, service requests, root‑cause analysis, and minor functional enhancements within Oracle Projects Cloud.
  • Ability to perform functional testing, regression cycles, and impact analysis during Oracle Cloud quarterly updates affecting Projects Cloud configurations and processes.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively with technical teams (OIC/ODI, REST/SOAP integrations) during troubleshooting of Projects Cloud integrations with Financials (GL, AP, AR, Assets) and upstream systems.
  • Strong documentation abilities for functional procedures, SOPs, test cases, configuration workbooks, and support logs related to Oracle Projects Cloud.

Additional information

Type of work: CLT, Flexible hours.

Benefits package: Transport vouchers, meal vouchers, childcare assistance, life insurance, funeral assistance, medical and dental insurance.

Career: Global work on national and international clients and/or projects, possibility of international career movement.

title: Credit Policy Specialist – LatAm
description:
What you'll do

We're looking for a Credit Strategy Specialist to design, implement, and optimize credit strategies that directly impact growth, risk, and customer experience. This role sits at the intersection of data, risk, and business, owning key levers such as credit policies, limit‑setting frameworks, and decision rules. You will work closely with Data, Operations, and Commercial teams to ensure we scale responsibly while maximizing approval rates and portfolio performance.

  • Own credit strategy design: Define and evolve underwriting policies, approval criteria, and limit‑setting frameworks.
  • Translate data into decisions: Leverage analytics and model outputs to drive actionable credit rules.
  • Optimize portfolio performance: Balance approval rates, revenue, and loss rates through continuous strategy iteration.
  • Design decision frameworks: Build and refine rules for acquisition, line increases, and ongoing exposure management.
  • Monitor and react to performance: Track key metrics (approval rate, NPLs, utilization, vintage curves) and adjust strategies accordingly.
  • Drive experimentation: Run A/B tests and controlled rollouts to improve credit outcomes.
  • Improve processes: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in underwriting and decisioning workflows using tools like N8N for automation where applicable.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally: Work with Product, Data, and Growth teams to align credit strategy with business goals, utilizing Metabase or Databricks for data visualization and analysis.

Must haves

  • 3+ years of experience in credit risk, strategy, or analytics within financial services or fintech.
  • Strong understanding of credit risk fundamentals (underwriting, exposure, loss drivers, portfolio dynamics).
  • Proven experience in credit policy design and implementation.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong data intuition.
  • Experience working with large datasets and analytical tools like Databricks.
  • Working proficiency in English and Portuguese.
  • Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows.
  • Adaptability to fast‑changing environments and excellent verbal and written communication.

Nice to haves

  • Experience in B2B lending, corporate cards, or fintech environments.
  • Exposure to Latin American markets and their specific data limitations.
  • Familiarity with decision engines or rule‑based systems.
  • Independent analytical skills using Python.
  • A good sense of humor.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.
  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language).
  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths.
  • High‑ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together.
  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact.
  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results.

Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in‑person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp‑up or when required by your leader.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times/ week or 8 days/ month) or Porto Alegre (3 times/ week or 12 days/ month). Our office culture is designed to foster in‑person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll lead initiatives that span front‑end and back‑end services — delivering performant, secure, and scalable features. You'll help define architecture, drive implementation, and collaborate closely with Design, PM, and Platform teams. You'll also work directly with our technical architects to help shape what we build — and how we build it. This is a high‑impact role in a growing, strategic product area with strong executive visibility.

Role Details

  • Design, build, and maintain end‑to‑end features using modern JavaScript and cloud‑native technologies (React, Node.js, Python, GoLang, TypeScript, PostgreSQL).

  • Mentor and support engineers across the team, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Experience

  • Deep expertise in TypeScript, ReactJS, and Node.js/Python/GoLang (Express or similar frameworks).

  • Experience designing APIs and building robust services at scale in a distributed, cloud‑based architecture.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Experience delivering elegant, enterprise‑grade user experiences by partnering with Product and Design teams in a fast‑paced, agile environment.

  • Ability to collaborate closely with Architects to make smart technical tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams.

  • Passion for craftsmanship and high engineering standards (testing, monitoring, documentation, scalability).

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and build consensus across functions.

  • A growth mindset and interest in mentoring others and upleveling the team.

Nice to Haves

  • Exposure to low‑code/no‑code tools, workflow engines, or visual development platforms.

  • Interest in AI‑assisted developer tooling or automation.

  • Experience working with 2d/3d rendering libraries.

Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s in computer science, or relevant industry experience.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting‑edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth‑stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Marketing at TRACTIAN

The Marketing team at Tractian crafts the narrative, defines messaging and positioning, and translates our groundbreaking products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our cross‑functional team, spanning Product Marketing, Customer Experience, Demand Generation, Branding, and Field Marketing, is dedicated to acquiring new customers and possesses a deep understanding of the business. We collaborate closely with many teams to show how we can help our clients reach their full potential.

What you’ll do

As a Product Marketing Specialist, your mission is to accelerate product adoption and customer education by connecting customer insights, data analysis, and scalable enablement strategies. You’ll ensure customers fully adopt and get value from Tractian technology, while also acting as a key partner in evaluating launches, training users, and identifying adoption opportunities. This role requires a mix of analytical, strategic, and executional skills. You’ll thrive if you enjoy connecting the dots between product data, customer behavior, and commercial outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze product usage data (PostHog, Amplitude, Heap, etc.) to identify friction points, adoption drivers, and opportunities for deeper engagement. Evaluate the success of product launches, highlighting where adoption or sales fell short and proposing next steps.
  • Run customer research initiatives (interviews, surveys, journey mapping) to validate assumptions and uncover adoption barriers.
  • Develop and deliver customer training programs in partnership with Customer Success and Product, helping users understand and adopt key product features.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and CS to translate behavioral data and customer feedback into adoption strategies and product improvements.
  • Build scalable enablement frameworks (in-app guidance, lifecycle campaigns, knowledge base content, and video tutorials) that reduce reliance on 1:1 interventions.
  • Create data-backed materials for Sales and CS, ensuring they can guide customers effectively through onboarding and expansion.
  • Ensure customer insights inform both the product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.

Requirements

  • Strong analytical background with proven experience using product analytics tools (PostHog, Amplitude, Heap, Mixpanel)
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in roles focused on product adoption, growth, customer lifecycle, or training.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and execute customer research initiatives.
  • Proven skills in turning complex data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Ability to scale education and adoption initiatives through automation and content.
  • Cross-functional collaborator, comfortable working with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and CS teams.

Bonus Points

  • Background in predictive maintenance, IoT, or industrial technologies.
  • Experience designing or delivering customer training programs.
  • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing.
  • Experience in product-led growth (PLG) environments.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and training sessions to diverse audiences.

description:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. If you’re ambitious, forward‑thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

This position is a key role focused on strategic financial management and the transformation of systems in the region. This role will be responsible for the comprehensive supervision of cash flow and forecasting, the efficient management of regional liquidity, and leading bank negotiations for the development of credit lines.

Main Responsibilities

  • Cash Flow & Forecasting: Supervise Regional cash forecasting process, challenge inputs, correct and align with global guidelines before reporting to Treasury Leadership.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Liaise with finance and other key areas to secure enforcement of treasury policies and processes. Including payment process, cash forecasting process, accounting closing and others.
  • Liquidity Management: Partner with Treasury leadership to monitor the status of regional liquidity. Assess on efficient cash management for the countries in scope including intercompany funding, investments, external financing.
  • Financing: Take an active role in credit line development for the region, negotiating with partner banks, setting up the adequate products for working capital support and liaising with internal teams to fulfill any information requirement for credit lines applications and renewals.
  • Banking Operations: Negotiate with banks on pricing and product availability. Support treasury leadership with insight about banking structure and suggest improvements.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Lead the process with local regulators, banks, and legal consultants to comply with regulatory processes and process cross-border payments.
  • Internal Control: Ensures full application of Treasury’s controls and policies, including signatories updates, segregation of duties, counterparty risk management, fraud prevention.
  • System Transformation: Provide technical support for the Treasury department during the migration and testing of SAP S/4HANA and H2H connectivity. Support migration for ISO messaging.
  • Project Support & Process Implementation: Act as an agent for process improvement, supporting the area’s strategic demands and implementing new treasury workflows and controls.
  • Reporting: Interact with Global Treasury to report liquidity figures and provide documentation for annual audit requirements. Secure clear understanding of variations and provide proper visibility for Treasury leadership.

Skills And Experience Required

  • Languages: Advanced English.
  • Systems:
    • Experience with Kyriba or other Treasury Management Systems (TMS).
    • Experience with SAP (Experience with S/4HANA migration is a plus).
    • Experience with banking tools and systems.
  • Technical Knowledge:
    • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
    • Knowledge of LATAM market regulations and FX operations.
  • Competencies:
    • Ability to clearly communicate and work with senior team members within finance and other key areas.
    • Strong focus on process implementation and optimization within fast‑paced environments.
    • Looks for improvement of opportunities leveraging not only on available system landscape but also with potential tools currently out of scope.
    • Knowledge of the Foreign Exchange Market regulations in the region.

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever‑changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

title: Finance & Accounting Analyst
description:
About Relay Commerce

Relay Commerce is building a portfolio of software solutions to help merchants scale e-commerce and simplify their marketing tech stack. Powered by a centralized customer data platform, Relay’s suite of software tools allows merchants to automate key revenue generation workflows to drive organic growth and increased profitability.

The Relay ecosystem currently consists of seven software products that accelerate merchant revenue growth through email marketing automation, user-generated content management, on-page conversion optimization, retention analytics, and bookings management. Relay’s products are established as key tools in the SMB e-commerce revenue generation stack, servicing more than 35K customers globally that collectively generate >$1BN in GMV annually.

Relay is actively building the ecosystem by acquiring commerce enablement tools primarily serving e-commerce merchants on platforms including Shopify, BigCommerce, and Wix. Relay acquires ‘ready to scale’, oftentimes bootstrapped businesses, and invests in people, processes, and products to accelerate the product roadmap and growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented Finance & Accounting Analyst with 5–7 years of experience to support our multi-entity accounting operations and business unit financial reporting. This role bridges accounting execution and finance analysis: you'll work closely with our Assistant Controller on month-end close while also partnering with business unit GMs on financial performance and reporting.

You’ll report to our US-based Director of Finance and work hands‑on in QuickBooks Online, Ramp, Syft, and Google Sheets. Beyond executing established processes, you’ll improve them by identifying inefficiencies, strengthening controls, and translating financial data into actionable insights for business leaders.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both the precision of accounting operations and the analytical challenge of explaining “why the numbers moved.” You’ll ensure accurate, timely reporting while helping GMs understand their financial performance and supporting our Assistant Controller during month‑end close.

What You’ll Do Daily

Business Unit Reporting & Analysis (35–45%)

  • Build and maintain BU dashboards and board reporting packages in Syft
  • Prepare monthly variance analysis (MoM and Budget vs. Actual) for GM reviews
  • Partner with GMs to understand their reporting needs and business drivers
  • Investigate and explain revenue, expense, and margin variances
  • Translate financial data into clear business insights for non‑finance stakeholders
  • Support ad‑hoc analysis requests from business units

Month‑End Close Support (30–45%)

  • Support Assistant Controller on assigned reconciliations and close tasks
  • Own deferred revenue recognition across SaaS products
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations for review
  • Analyze account balances and proactively investigate discrepancies
  • Coordinate intercompany and cross‑BU transactions
  • Ensure assigned close tasks are completed accurately and on schedule

Expense Management & Operational Reporting (5–15%)

  • Own Ramp expense reporting, categorization, and trend analysis
  • Review expense coding for accuracy and consistency across BUs
  • Monitor expense trends and flag anomalies or policy issues proactively
  • Maintain reporting dashboards and BU‑level financial templates
  • Ensure data integrity between accounting systems and reporting outputs
  • Improve workflows between QuickBooks, Ramp, Syft, and other platforms

Process Improvement & Documentation (5%)

  • Identify opportunities to streamline reporting and close processes
  • Document financial processes and improve cross‑functional workflows
  • Strengthen controls and data quality across systems
  • Support audit preparation and financial controls documentation

What Success Looks Like

In Month 1–2:

  • You independently manage assigned reconciliations and reporting tasks
  • You understand the multi‑entity structure and BU business models
  • You begin building relationships with GM stakeholders

In Month 3–6:

  • BU variance analysis is insightful and proactive (GMs come to you with questions)
  • Syft dashboards and board packages run smoothly with minimal rework
  • You support month‑end close efficiently and catch issues before escalation
  • Deferred revenue recognition is clean and well‑documented

In Month 6–12:

  • You operate as the go‑to person for BU financial reporting and GM questions
  • You proactively identify trends and insights before being asked
  • You contribute meaningful process improvements that save time or increase accuracy
  • You provide reliable backup coverage for Assistant Controller when needed

Requirements

  • 5–7 years of accounting or finance operations experience
  • Month‑end close experience, including reconciliations and journal entries
  • Experience working in multi‑entity or multi‑business‑unit environments
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable explaining variances and digging into “why”
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online or other cloud accounting platforms
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling, variance analysis)
  • Understanding of US GAAP fundamentals
  • Experience with financial reporting tools and dashboards
  • AI‑savvy: Uses AI to work smarter while maintaining quality and judgment
  • Clear written English communication for async collaboration
  • Availability for 4–5 hours overlap with US Eastern Time

Preferred

  • SaaS, technology, or e‑commerce experience (deferred revenue, MRR, cohorts)
  • Familiarity with expense management platforms (Ramp, Expensify, Brex, etc.)
  • Experience with financial reporting/BI tools (Syft, Fathom, QuickBooks, etc.)
  • Previous experience supporting business unit leaders or non‑finance stakeholders
  • Experience improving financial processes or building reporting infrastructure
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Vem Ser CSixer | Banco de Talentos para Pessoas com Deficiência

São Paulo, Brazil

Antes mesmo do lançamento do banco, estabelecemos, junto com toda a equipe, os valores em que acreditamos e que melhor definem o jeito de trabalhar que escolhemos. Os CSixers (como chamamos, informalmente, todos que trabalham no C6 Bank) participaram dessa construção para definir, por meio de situações já vividas, os comportamentos que gostaríamos de ver (e não ver) em cada valor. Nossa cultura nos reúne em torno de seis valores comuns, fortalecendo as relações pessoais e profissionais dentro do banco e desenvolvendo o sentimento de pertencimento dos colaboradores.

Valores

  • Ética : Sem isso, não tem nem conversa. Com esse pilar, tudo o que queremos construir será sólido, duradouro e verdadeiro. Fazemos o que é correto.
  • Desafiar o status quo : Dá para fazer diferente? Sempre dá. E pode ser simples. Temos paixão por transformar e evoluir.
  • Escolhemos o frescobol : Aqui ninguém ganha sozinho. Quando uma pessoa erra, o outro arredonda a bola. É uma relação de ganha-ganha.
  • Bom humor : Bom humor é fundamental. O clima bom e descontraído favorece as relações, a criatividade e a inovação. "Mas apelou, perdeu."
  • Autorcracia : Autorcracia significa ter liberdade com responsabilidade. Se a empresa fosse minha, eu faria isso?
  • Exercemos a arte de discordar : Perguntamos “por que” antes de discordar e não nos apaixonamos pelos próprios argumentos. Assim, podemos compreender para discordar e construir a melhor solução.

Esse profissional deverá ter habilidade em liderança, forte visão analítica e conhecimento das melhores práticas em vendas online e marketing digital, com o objetivo de atingir e superar as metas estabelecidas pela empresa.

Na busca pela posição de Gerente de Vendas Web, é fundamental possuir uma sólida experiência na área de Administração Comercial e Vendas, com foco em estratégias digitais. O candidato ideal deve ter, no mínimo, cinco anos de experiência comprovada em funções relacionadas a vendas online, com ênfase na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento em plataformas digitais.É essencial ter conhecimentos profundos em métricas de desempenho de vendas, gestão de funil de vendas online, e ferramentas de CRM, além de uma compreensão robusta de marketing digital, SEO e análise de dados. Habilidades de comunicação e negociação são igualmente importantes, assim como a capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança.O candidato deve ser proficiente em utilizar plataformas de vendas online e conhecer as melhores práticas em gestão de e-commerce. title: FARMACEUTICA DA QUALIDADE - Noturno
description:
OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Responsável por garantir que todos os gases produzidos sejam seguros para uso em aplicações médicas e industriais, cumprindo rigorosamente todas as normas e diretrizes regulatórias. Além disso, o profissional deve promover a otimização contínua dos processos produtivos, garantindo eficiência operacional e redução de riscos, alinhada aos desafios tecnológicos e de sustentabilidade da indústria.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATIVIDADES

  1. Assuntos Regulatórios:
    • Desenvolver e implementar sistemas de gestão da qualidade para assegurar a conformidade com as normas da ANVISA e outras regulamentações.
  2. Cadastramento e Registros:
    • Realizar o cadastramento de cilindros medicinais e válvulas, além de gerenciar registros de produção e etiquetagem, assegurando a rastreabilidade completa dos produtos.
  3. Controle e Garantia da Qualidade:
    • Conduzir análises finais dos produtos medicinais para liberação, garantindo que todos os cilindros, lacres e etiquetas estejam em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade.
    • Supervisionar a produção de gases medicinais e industriais, assegurando que os processos sejam executados de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  4. Operações Logísticas e Controle de Estoque:
    • Coordenar a conferência regular de estoque de gases e materiais, garantindo que os registros físicos e contábeis estejam alinhados e precisos.
    • Realizar inventário semanal de cilindros e manutenção preventiva de equipamentos, incluindo a calibração de analisadores.
  5. Educação e Treinamento:
    • Elaborar e participar de programas de treinamento e Diálogo Diário de Segurança (DDS), promovendo a educação contínua da equipe sobre práticas de qualidade e segurança.
  6. Auditorias e Qualidade Interna:
    • Realizar auditorias internas anuais para avaliar a eficácia dos sistemas de qualidade e identificar áreas de melhoria.
    • Avaliar e qualificar fornecedores para garantir a qualidade e conformidade dos materiais utilizados.
  7. Produção e Inspeção de Gases:
    • Monitorar e lançar a produção de gases medicinais e industriais, assegurando a qualidade na liberação in loco de produtos e na inspeção de integridade de cilindros.
  8. Manutenção e Calibração:
    • Controlar e acompanhar as ações de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, incluindo a calibração de analisadores e instrumentos utilizados.
  9. Controle de Embalagens e Materiais:
    • Gerenciar o recebimento, armazenamento e controle de materiais de embalagem, como lacres e etiquetas.
  10. Documentação e Atendimento a Clientes:
    • Gerenciar o envio de documentos internos solicitados pelos clientes e atender motoristas de revenda, garantindo a precisão em cálculos de descarregamento e na emissão de laudos de análise.
    • Controlar perdas relacionadas ao descarregamento de líquidos controlados e gerenciar atualizações e correções no sistema computadorizado utilizado pelo laboratório.
  11. Passagem de Gases Padrões:
    • Realizar checagem de calibração dos analisadores através da passagem de gases padrões, garantindo a precisão dos resultados.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

  • Formação Educacional: Graduação em Farmácia, com registro ativo no conselho regional de farmácia.
  • Experiência Desejada: Experiência prévia em controle de qualidade ou garantia de qualidade na indústria farmacêutica ou de gases medicinais.
  • Pontos de Atenção: Familiaridade com normas ISO e Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF).

REQUISITOS “CHAVE”

CONHECIMENTO

  1. Compreensão dos processos de produção e enchimento de gases.
  2. Conhecimento das normas e regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor de gases, como as normas da ABNT, ANVISA e outras diretrizes que asseguram a qualidade e segurança dos produtos.
  3. Entendimento das propriedades dos gases manuseados, como pressão, temperatura e comportamento em diferentes condições, para garantir o manuseio seguro e eficaz.
  4. Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão da qualidade específicos para gases, incluindo auditorias, controle de qualidade e metodologias de melhoria contínua.
  5. Conhecimento aprofundado das práticas de segurança no manuseio e armazenamento de gases comprimidos, incluindo o uso correto de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs).

HABILIDADES

  1. Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente a equipe, motivando os operadores a seguir os procedimentos de segurança e qualidade rigorosamente.
  2. Habilidade para comunicar informações técnicas complexas de forma clara e eficaz para a equipe, gerência e reguladores.
  3. Aptidão para diagnosticar rapidamente problemas operacionais e implementar soluções eficazes, minimizando o impacto na produção e na segurança.
  4. Competência para planejar e coordenar as atividades de produção, garantindo a otimização dos recursos e o cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
  5. Habilidade para analisar dados de produção e qualidade, utilizando insights para melhorar continuamente os processos e a eficiência operacional.

title: OPERADOR DE ESTOQUE - CD GO - EXPEDIÇÃO
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o controle de estoque, efetivando as entradas de produtos no sistema, armazenando os medicamentos de acordo com o POP da área.
  • Realizar periodicamente a conferência dos endereços, verificando se as mercadorias estão alocadas em seus devidos lugares.
  • Localizar os produtos no estoque, conferindo descrição e dosagem.
  • Retirar os medicamentos do estoque.
  • Conferir os medicamentos a serem embalados seguindo pedido do cliente.
  • Dar saída nos medicamentos, enviando às transportadoras.
  • Receber a documentação entregue pela transportadora, conferindo o número de volumes e conteúdo de cada volume.
  • Conferir as informações contidas nas notas fiscais, comparando-as com as caixas.
  • Dar entrada nos produtos recebidos, inserindo os medicamentos no sistema da empresa.
  • Avisar o setor de Armazenamento através de relatório, quais produtos estão na área de quarentena.
  • Realizar o armazenamento nos locais corretos, conforme procedimento e verificar se as mercadorias estão bem acondicionadas.
  • Checar o posicionamento das caixas, verificando se elas estão sendo empilhadas de acordo com as recomendações quanto à fragilidade e empilhamento máximo.
  • Manter as caixas no estoque de forma bem organizada.
  • Operar paleteira (elétrica/ manual) para armazenamento de produtos.
  • Retirar os medicamentos do estoque, obedecendo à ordem cronológica de seus lotes de fabricação, de maneira a separar primeiro os lotes mais antigos.
  • Retirar do estoque produtos com menos de 90 dias do vencimento, seguindo relatório de validade curta recebido.
  • Conferir os pedidos dos clientes, utilizando os leitores e coletores de dados para se certificar que os produtos estão de acordo com o que foi solicitado (quantidade e lote).
  • Quando o pedido do cliente chegar na conferência, certificar-se que as etiquetas estão de acordo com a ficha de separação.
  • Emitir os conhecimentos às transportadoras.
  • Conferir os pedidos vindos do setor de embalagem, se estão de acordo com a Nota Fiscal, roteirizando as cargas.
  • Montar as cargas dos pedidos de acordo com as rotas e transportadoras.
  • Identificar os paletes dos pedidos, para que sejam embarcados corretamente.
  • Efetuar o carregamento das cargas nos carros das devidas transportadoras.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 100 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y C. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

  • Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
  • Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
  • Customer Obsession . Our customers' product is our product.
  • Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
  • First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

Our Challenges

Our job is solid software engineering, not hype engineering. Carrier APIs differ a lot across countries, providers and regulatory regimes. Provisioning, porting, and eSIM lifecycle management happen in real-time with hard SLA requirements. Usage tracking, billing, and payments span multiple currencies and jurisdictions. Our systems need to be observable, operable, and resilient. When a carrier integration fails at 3am in a market far away, we need to know about it before the customer does.

Ours is a world where decades-old carrier protocols meet eSIMs, IoT, satellite connectivity, and the road to 6G. We are bridging that gap; making the old world programmable for the new one. We’re a platform company solving real, durable problems that don’t disappear when the hype cycle turns.

Our engineering team is doubling in 2026. In the next step of our journey, we’re building out a senior IC track, hiring multiple staff and principal engineers, because the challenges we’re solving today are only getting deeper. New markets, new connectivity paradigms, and an architecture that needs to carry us for years, not quarters.

Who You Are

You’ve seen what good and bad look like. You bring experience of operating at scale (technological or organizational) and you know systems and practices that hold up under pressure both from experience and literature. We’re looking for someone who can work across teams, connecting the technical dots between them. Someone who spots domain boundary problems before they become production incidents, and who builds the patterns and processes that the teams around them adopt and keep.

What you will do

  • Design and evolve cross-cutting architectures (event-driven systems, multi-carrier integrations, multi-tenant platform patterns) and establish the governance and review practices to keep them coherent as we grow.
  • Raise the bar on operational excellence. Not just the systems (observability, SLOs, graceful degradation) but the processes and culture around incident response, on-call, and production ownership.
  • Find the places where AI changes the work, primarily in our platform and engineering practices, and push those forward.
  • Mentor senior engineers and help define what the senior IC growth path looks like at Gigs.
  • Ship production code and shape technical strategy with our engineering leadership.

What we are looking for

You’ve seen what good and bad look like. You bring experience of operating at scale (technological or organizational) and you know systems and practices that hold up under pressure both from experience and literature. We’re looking for someone who can work across teams, connecting the technical dots between them. Someone who spots domain boundary problems before they become production incidents, and who builds the patterns and processes that the teams around them adopt and keep.

What We Expect on Day 1 (and in the Interviews)

  • Experience developing, running, and maintaining distributed systems and event-driven architectures at scale.
  • Strong operational instincts. You think about observability, failure modes, alerting, and graceful degradation as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts. You’ve built systems that are debuggable by someone who didn’t write them.
  • Experience navigating and rationalizing polyglot environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with experience operating in an international organisation.
  • Experience with agentic AI development. You’ve worked with LLMs beyond code completion, understand agentic patterns, and have opinions on when AI is the right tool and when it isn’t.
  • Track record of driving technical outcomes across teams without direct authority. You persuade through credibility and evidence, not rank.
  • Engineers around you got better because you were there, and you can point to specifics.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telecom, payments, or multi-market API platforms.
  • Familiarity with any of our stack (Ruby, Go, TypeScript, Python).
  • Experience at companies during a similar scaling phase (50 → 200 engineers).
  • Background in domain-driven design or platform/product boundary work.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan.

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

description:
# Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack#### São Paulo, São Paulo, BrazilSenior Software Engineer, Full Stack**Engineering at Brex**Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.**What you’ll do**As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer on our Task Workflows Platform team, you will build and scale the foundational infrastructure that powers core experiences across Brex. You will work across our extensive suite of platforms - including our multi-channel notifications engine, collaborative commenting system, and dynamic workflow rule builder. You will also play a pivotal role in evolving our task orchestration infrastructure infrastructure, helping us transition from a centralized, generic experience into highly tailored, purpose-built solutions for specific product domains.You will tackle complex full-stack challenges, from designing scalable backend APIs and rule-evaluation engines for custom automations, to crafting intuitive frontend UX for our domain-specific task interfaces and workflow builders. Beyond core platform work, you will be part of a team that directly shapes broader product experiences - including leveraging AI to streamline user workflows and supporting the continuous evolution of our productivity tools in web and mobile.**Where you’ll work**This role will be based in Sao Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!**Responsibilities*** Work with engineers across the company to build new features and products end-to-end* Own problems end-to-end, thinking through everything from user experience, data models, scalability, operability and ongoing metrics.* Provide technical leadership to team by driving roadmap direction, architectural design and mentorship* Work side-by-side with user-facing teams (Sales, Support) to best understand the needs of our customers.* Tune and polish features to a high degree of excellence.* Identify and implement reliability and performance improvements* Uphold our high engineering standards and bring consistency to the codebases, infrastructure, and processes you will encounter.**Requirements*** 7+ years of professional experience designing, developing, and deploying full-stack products* Strong proficiency in backend programming languages (Java, Kotlin, Python)* Experience architecting, building, and maintaining scalable, high-availability distributed systems* Experience designing and optimizing SQL and/or NoSQL databases, including data modeling, query performance tuning, and schema design* Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL services* Experience with modern frontend technologies and tools like ES6+, React, TypeScript, and Webpack.**Bonus points*** Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and specialists in product, design, and operations* Experience driving initiatives at a broader level across an organization or company* Experience running in-product experiments, A/B testing* Experience and interest in leveraging AI developer tools.Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.*Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.***Why join us**Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Será responsável por traduzir as necessidades operacionais e as regras de negócio em configurações sistêmicas otimizadas dentro do ecossistema de Intralogística (WMS, WCS, TMS, etc). Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior (cursos de Ciência da Computação, Sistemas da Informação, Engenharia, Administração e correlatos);
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência fazendo gestão de sistemas de intralogística;
  • Sistemas de Logística, como WMS, WCS e TMS;

description:

Como Assistente de Loja na H&M, você desempenhará um papel fundamental na criação de uma experiência excepcional para o cliente. Você dará as boas‑vindas aos clientes, os guiará pela loja e os apoiará a encontrar o que precisam enquanto apresenta nossos produtos. Agindo de acordo com nossos valores, você contribuirá para o seu próprio sucesso e para o sucesso da empresa.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 100 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y C. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

  • Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
  • Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
  • Customer Obsession . Our customers' product is our product.
  • Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
  • First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

Our Challenges

Our job is solid software engineering, not hype engineering. Carrier APIs differ a lot across countries, providers and regulatory regimes. Provisioning, porting, and eSIM lifecycle management happen in real-time with hard SLA requirements. Usage tracking, billing, and payments span multiple currencies and jurisdictions. Our systems need to be observable, operable, and resilient. When a carrier integration fails at 3am in a market far away, we need to know about it before the customer does.

Ours is a world where decades-old carrier protocols meet eSIMs, IoT, satellite connectivity, and the road to 6G. We are bridging that gap; making the old world programmable for the new one. We’re a platform company solving real, durable problems that don’t disappear when the hype cycle turns.

Our engineering team is doubling in 2026. In the next step of our journey, we’re building out a senior IC track, hiring multiple staff and principal engineers, because the challenges we’re solving today are only getting deeper. New markets, new connectivity paradigms, and an architecture that needs to carry us for years, not quarters.

Who You Are

You’ve seen what good and bad look like. You bring experience of operating at scale (technological or organizational) and you know systems and practices that hold up under pressure both from experience and literature. We’re looking for someone who can work across teams, connecting the technical dots between them. Someone who spots domain boundary problems before they become production incidents, and who builds the patterns and processes that the teams around them adopt and keep.

What you will do

  • Design and evolve cross-cutting architectures (event-driven systems, multi-carrier integrations, multi-tenant platform patterns) and establish the governance and review practices to keep them coherent as we grow.
  • Raise the bar on operational excellence. Not just the systems (observability, SLOs, graceful degradation) but the processes and culture around incident response, on-call, and production ownership.
  • Find the places where AI changes the work, primarily in our platform and engineering practices, and push those forward.
  • Mentor senior engineers and help define what the senior IC growth path looks like at Gigs.
  • Ship production code and shape technical strategy with our engineering leadership.

What we are looking for

You’ve seen what good and bad look like. You bring experience of operating at scale (technological or organizational) and you know systems and practices that hold up under pressure both from experience and literature. We’re looking for someone who can work across teams, connecting the technical dots between them. Someone who spots domain boundary problems before they become production incidents, and who builds the patterns and processes that the teams around them adopt and keep.

What We Expect on Day 1 (and in the Interviews)

  • Experience developing, running, and maintaining distributed systems and event-driven architectures at scale.
  • Strong operational instincts. You think about observability, failure modes, alerting, and graceful degradation as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts. You’ve built systems that are debuggable by someone who didn’t write them.
  • Experience navigating and rationalizing polyglot environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with experience operating in an international organisation.
  • Experience with agentic AI development. You’ve worked with LLMs beyond code completion, understand agentic patterns, and have opinions on when AI is the right tool and when it isn’t.
  • Track record of driving technical outcomes across teams without direct authority. You persuade through credibility and evidence, not rank.
  • Engineers around you got better because you were there, and you can point to specifics.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telecom, payments, or multi-market API platforms.
  • Familiarity with any of our stack (Ruby, Go, TypeScript, Python).
  • Experience at companies during a similar scaling phase (50 → 200 engineers).
  • Background in domain-driven design or platform/product boundary work.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan.

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

title: Instituto ACP tem vaga para Gerente Financeira e de Operações
description:
O Instituto ACP está com processo seletivo aberto para a nova posição de Gerente Financeira e de Operações , com atuação em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido e contratação no regime CLT. As inscrições podem ser feitas até 18 de fevereiro, embora as entrevistas possam ocorrer antes do encerramento do prazo.

Descrição da Vaga

O Instituto ACP passou por um crescimento significativo nos últimos anos, ampliando sua atuação, o volume de recursos geridos e sua complexidade institucional. Até aqui, a área administrativa-financeira operou com uma estrutura enxuta e bastante operacional. Esse modelo cumpriu seu papel, mas já não responde às necessidades atuais do Instituto.

Por isso, estamos criando a posição deGerência Financeira e de Operações — uma vaganova , com papel central naestruturação, qualificação e consolidação da gestão financeira do IACP.

O eixo prioritário desta posição é o financeiro. A principal responsabilidade da Gerência é estruturar processos, instrumentos, rotinas e controles financeiros sólidos, confiáveis e capazes de sustentar o crescimento institucional e a tomada de decisão.

As responsabilidades relacionadas aoperações institucionais (RH, jurídico e produção de eventos) são complementares e estarão a serviço de uma gestão financeira bem estruturada e integrada.

Esta não é uma gerência que herda processos prontos. É uma posição voltada àcriação de instrumentos e métodos , com foco em redução de riscos, clareza de informações e fortalecimento da governança.

A posição responde diretamente àDireção Executiva , atua em diálogo próximo com oConselho Fiscal e mantém interlocução pontual com oConselho Diretor e a Assembleia , apoiando a produção e qualificação de informações financeiras e operacionais para as instâncias de governança.

Atualmente, a equipe é mínima, composta por uma analista administrativa-financeira,por isso trata-se de uma posição de liderança técnica e atuação mão na massa.

Esta posiçãonão é umaliderança financeira ,com responsabilidades operacionais associadas.

Prioridade central da posição: gestão financeira e governança

  • Estruturar e qualificar os processos financeiros do Instituto (orçamento, fluxo de caixa, controle por projetos, conciliações, fechamentos mensais).
  • Criar, revisar e implementarinstrumentos financeiros , comoplanilhas estruturadas, relatórios gerenciais, controles por projeto e fluxos de aprovação , priorizando simplicidade, padronização e redução de erros.
  • Coordenar o planejamento orçamentário anual e o acompanhamento sistemático da execução.
  • Garantir a organização, confiabilidade e rastreabilidade das informações financeiras.
  • Preparar, qualificar e sistematizar informações financeiras para aDireção Executiva, Conselho Fiscal, Conselho Diretor e Assembleia .
  • Atuar como principal interlocução da área financeira com oConselho Fiscal .
  • Elaborar relatórios, apresentações e subsídios para reuniões das instâncias de governança.
  • Acompanhar auditorias, prestações de contas e a relação com contabilidade externa.
  • Garantir conformidade com exigências legais, fiscais e institucionais do terceiro setor.

Responsabilidades complementares: operações institucionais

  • Estruturar e coordenar processos administrativos e operacionais relacionados aRH, jurídico e produção de eventos.
  • Fazer a interface com fornecedores e assessorias externas (contábil, jurídica, RH, eventos).
  • Criar rotinas, fluxos e instrumentos que deem sustentação operacional às atividades do Instituto.

Liderança e articulação interna

  • Coordenar tecnicamente o trabalho da analista, garantindo a integração entre finanças, operações e as demais áreas do Instituto.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura organizacional do IACP, baseada em confiança, transparência e colaboração.

Requisitos

  • Experiência obrigatória em organizações da sociedade civil (OSCs, fundações, institutos ou organizações similares).
  • Experiência profissional consolidada em gestão financeira.
  • Experiência comprovada emestruturação de áreas financeiras , criação de processos e instrumentos de controle.
  • Conhecimento sólido de orçamento, fluxo de caixa, prestação de contas e acompanhamento financeiro por projetos.
  • Experiência naprodução de informações e relatórios para instâncias de governança , como conselhos e assembleias.
  • Familiaridade com auditorias, controles internos e conformidade institucional.
  • Excelente domínio de planilhas e organização de informações financeiras.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia com osistema OngSys .
  • Conhecimento deinglês e/ou espanhol .
  • Identificação com a missão e os valores da sociedade civil organizada.
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico e responsável.
  • Conforto para atuar em contextos em construção, com equipe reduzida.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e visão sistêmica.
  • Boa comunicação e disposição para o trabalho colaborativo em estrutura horizontal.
  • Capacidade de equilibrar rigor técnico e pragmatismo.
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Salário : A/C
  • Benefícios: plano de saúde e odontológico, vale alimentação
  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo (modelo híbrido)

As inscrições serão aceitas até 18/02/2026, mas as entrevistas poderão ocorrer antes do encerramento do prazo.

title: Refúgio 343 abre vaga para Gerente de Marketing e Captação de Recursos
description:
Detalhes da Vaga

Sediado em São Paulo (SP), o Refúgio 343 está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Marketing e Captação de Recursos para liderar as duas áreas, que têm em comum o desafio de conscientizar a sociedade brasileira sobre o desafio migratório que estamos vivendo e garantir a sustentabilidade financeira da organização.

A organização é dedicada à reinserção socioeconômica de refugiados e migrantes. Vivemos o que é hoje a maior crise migratória do mundo. Para apoiá-los, o Refúgio 343 trabalha com os pilares de acolhimento e educação para garantir a integração dos beneficiários por todo território nacional de forma sistematizada, ativando a comunidade brasileira e empresas.

Responsabilidades

O(A) profissional será responsável pelo gerenciamento dos diferentes pilares de Captação de Recursos, alavancando o Programa de Doadores, doações por empresas, editais, emendas parlamentares, eventos, entre outras, garantindo assim a diversificação das fontes de receita. Também será responsável pela gestão e execução (em menor escala) das atividades de prospecção de novos doadores e retenção dos atuais, através de réguas de relacionamento segmentadas para cada frente. Faz parte do seu escopo de trabalho o desenvolvimento da área de Marketing, do plano de comunicação, estratégias de campanhas de marketing digital para captação de recursos, engajando pessoas e empresas a atuarem em prol da causa. Faz parte das suas atribuições garantir o cumprimento das metas, monitorar ferramentas de gestão e reportar indicadores periodicamente para o CEO.

  • Desenvolver as áreas de Captação de Recursos e Marketing, incluindo a contratação e o desenvolvimento de pessoas, processos e fluxos de trabalho;
  • Desenvolver novas frentes de captação de recursos e potencializar as atuais (digital, F2F, captação junto ao governo, incentivos fiscais, doação pessoa física e jurídica), criando fontes diversificadas de receita;
  • Construir relacionamento junto ao governo para ampliar as possibilidades de captação de recursos via emendas parlamentares e outras fontes de arrecadação;
  • Construir e gerenciar o orçamento das áreas, analisar indicadores e elaborar relatórios para subsidiar a gestão;
  • Coordenar as ações de prospecção de doadores corporativos e preparar propostas de patrocínio customizadas de acordo com o potencial parceiro;
  • Liderar a execução do plano estratégico de captação de recursos, em prol da sustentabilidade financeira da organização;
  • Supervisionar/revisar inscrições em editais nacionais e internacionais;
  • Planejar, organizar e gerir campanhas e eventos para captação de recursos, bem como realizar o monitoramento dos indicadores de CRM e alimentar a base de dados;
  • Analizar comportamento do doador para criar régua de relacionamento, a fim de melhorar a comunicação com doadores;
  • Gerenciar redes sociais (Instagram, Facebook e LinkedIn), plataformas de marketing digital (CRM), E-mail Marketing e gerenciador de anúncios online (anúncios no Google Ads e Grants, Meta Ads, entre outros);
  • Gestão e eventual desenvolvimento de peças criativas para captação (texto e criativo, incluindo audiovisual);
  • Gerir e desenvolver campanhas de marketing (fortalecimento da marca, fidelização de doadores e aquisição de leads para conversão);
  • Supervisionar o trabalho da analista junto à assessoria de imprensa, com informações sobre a Operação, a fim de criar pautas relevantes junto à imprensa;
  • Supervisionar a atualização de informações do site e material institucional;
  • Representar a organização em eventos e fóruns quando necessário.

Requisitos

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Superior completo em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Residir na cidade de São Paulo ou Belo Horizonte.
  • Experiência profissional de pelo menos 5 anos em Captação de Recursos/Marketing Digital, de preferência em organizações do terceiro setor;
  • Conhecimento da legislação federal, estadual e municipal aplicáveis às ONGs;
  • Desejável experiência em gestão de eventos;
  • Desejável experiência na gestão de pessoas;
  • Desejável experiência com gestão de banco de dados;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais;
  • Desejável Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • Domínio do pacote Office (em especial Excel avançado) e ferramentas de CRM;
  • Conhecimento em Google Drive e suas ferramentas;
  • Familiaridade com Adobe Creative Cloud;
  • Habilidade para se comunicar frente a diferentes públicos e excelente redação para desenvolver textos de relacionamento e engajamento;
  • O(A) profissional deverá ter estrutura e equipamentos próprios para trabalhar em casa.

Qualidades Pessoais

  • Participativo, comprometido, colaborativo, entusiasmado, organizado, flexível e adaptável a diferentes contextos de trabalho e pessoas;
  • Foco em resultados e orientação à ação;
  • Bom planejamento e organização, definição de prioridades;
  • Autoconhecimento e inteligência emocional;
  • Habilidade de liderança;
  • Visão estratégica e analítica;
  • Amor aos detalhes;
  • Proativo para propor mudanças e melhorias.

Benefícios e Condições de Trabalho

  • Jornada de trabalho de 40 horas semanais;
  • Trabalho híbrido (maior parte dos dias da semana em home office);
  • Investimento de R$ 1.000 em desenvolvimento após 12 meses de trabalho;
  • Folga no dia do aniversário;
  • Recesso coletivo cedido na semana entre o Natal e Ano Novo sem desconto nas férias;
  • 30 dias de férias remuneradas;
  • 4 meses de licença maternidade e paternidade, incluindo adoção;
  • Flexibilidade e autonomia de trabalho.

Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário, respondendo todas as perguntas e anexando o seu CV e Carta de Motivação até o dia 21/02/2024 . Os documentos devem estar em pdf e nomeados da seguinte forma: NOME SOBRENOME_CV e NOME SOBRENOME_CARTA DE MOTIVAÇÃO. Boa sorte!

Seeking a QA resource with experience in Underwriting and Policy Administration systems within the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain.   • SQL knowledge for backend data validation and reconciliation.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with business and technical teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting testing activities for application migration, modernization, or workflow transformation initiatives.

Visão da Operação AI First

Responsabilidades principais

  • Familiaridade com limitações reais de desenvolvimento

  • Não esperamos um desenvolvedor, mas alguém que não depende do dev para pensar em soluções
  • Design com IA

description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a oportunidade

O SENAI Goiás abre cadastro de profissionais interessados em prestar serviços técnicos, especializados e educacionais em suas unidades, conforme demandas institucionais específicas.

A atuação dar-se-á exclusivamente na modalidade de prestação de serviços, podendo ser realizada por prestador de serviços autônomo ou por meio de Pessoa Jurídica (PJ), não sendo exigida qualquer forma de exclusividade, ficando o prestador de serviços livre para atender outros contratantes, simultaneamente ou não, além do SENAI Goiás.

Este cadastro não se trata de vaga para contratação no regime CLT, mas sim da formação de um banco de profissionais que poderão ser convidados a atuar de forma pontual e eventual, conforme necessidades institucionais.

Objetivo do cadastro

O objetivo deste cadastro é possibilitar que profissionais qualificados se inscrevam para eventuais prestação de serviços, conforme a necessidade das unidades do SENAI Goiás, para atuação especialmente em atividades de docência, como condução de cursos e treinamentos, podendo também envolver participação em projetos, consultorias, capacitações ou outras atividades técnicas e educacionais.

O eventual convite ocorrerá exclusivamente mediante necessidade das unidades do SENAI Goiás e compatibilidade do perfil profissional com a demanda existente.

Possíveis áreas de atuação

As demandas poderão contemplar, entre outras, as seguintes áreas:

  • Manutenção automotiva
  • Aviação
  • Elétrica
  • Eletrônica
  • Automação
  • Mecânica Industrial
  • Soldagem
  • Química
  • Construção Civil
  • Segurança do Trabalho
  • Vestuário
  • Alimentos e Bebidas
  • Logística
  • Gestão
  • Tecnologia da Informação
  • Design Gráfico
  • Intérprete de Libras

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos para inscrição

Podem se inscrever profissionais que:

  • Possuam formação em cursos de qualificação, formação técnica, graduação e/ou pós-graduação, mestrado e/ou doutorado, conforme a área de atuação;
  • Possuam experiência profissional compatível com os serviços a serem prestados;
  • Tenham interesse e disponibilidade para atuar como prestador de serviços autônomos ou por meio de Pessoa Jurídica;
  • Possuam disponibilidade para atuação eventual, conforme demanda institucional;
  • Tenham disponibilidade para atuação nas unidades do Senai Goiás localizadas no estado de Goiás.

Essas informações serão utilizadas para análise de compatibilidade com eventuais demandas institucionais.

Informações adicionais

Orientações para o cadastro do currículo

Durante a inscrição, é necessário que o candidato:

Cadastre seu currículo completo e atualizado na plataforma, informando:

  • Formações acadêmicas;
  • Cursos, certificações e capacitações;
  • Experiências profissionais, com descrição das atividades executadas;
  • Áreas de especialidade e atuação;
  • Localidade de interesse para atuação;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Forma de atuação para a prestação dos serviços: Autônomo ou PJ.

Modalidade de atuação

  • Prestação de serviços autônomos ou por meio de Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).

Observação: Não se trata de contratação no regime CLT.

Informações importantes

  • A inscrição neste banco de profissionais não gera direito à contratação, nem obrigatoriedade de convite para prestação de serviços por parte do SENAI Goiás;
  • Os profissionais cadastrados poderão ser contatados conforme a necessidade das unidades e a compatibilidade do perfil com a demanda existente;
  • As atividades possuem caráter pontual e eventual, sendo formalizadas por meio de contratação de prestação de serviços;
  • Os valores de hora técnica ou hora/aula serão informados no momento do convite, de acordo com a natureza da atividade e da demanda específica.

surface early risk signals and recommended mitigations to secure retention and growth.* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.* Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.* Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes* Excellent program management and cross-functional influence skills.* Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus* Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders.## **Great to have**AI Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of AI capabilities within Zendesk’s platform, not necessarily hands-on technical, but sufficient to translate product features into business value and strategic initiatives.#LI-MR7Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. Posting Date: 10 Apr 2026

Location: Rio de Janeiro, BR,

Contract Type: Permanent
